sanskrit_verse: कर्मोपकरणं चैषां क्रियां प्रति यदाहृतम् । आप्तभावेन कुर्वीत न जिह्मेण समाचरेत् ॥
transliteration: karmopakaraṇaṃ caiṣāṃ kriyāṃ prati yad āhṛtam | āptabhāvena kurvīta na jihmena samācaret ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One must perform actions and their instrumental supports with sincerity and integrity; not through deceit or indirect means.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from alignment with Dharma, not manipulation
Causation arises from pure intention, not external coercion
Capacity-based responsibility requires truthful engagement in action
Restoration logic demands congruence between inner state and outer conduct
Consciousness alignment necessitates rejection of duplicity in performance
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent performs an act through indirect or deceptive means THEN the act shall be deemed invalid for legal recognition.
IF a duty-bound individual engages in action without aptabhāva (integrity) THEN realignment protocols MUST initiate prior to continuation of civic participation.
ALL juridical acts MUST include verification of motivational transparency as prerequisite for validity.
NO legal consequence shall proceed where jihma (deceit) is established as operational mode.
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, intent integrity determines procedural legitimacy. Acts performed under guise or pretense are nullified ex facie. The court must establish that all parties have acted with aptabhāva before proceeding to substantive review.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that outcome distortion follows naturally from insincere causation. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that misaligned action leads to dissonance requiring conscious recalibration rather than punitive correction. Proportionality aligns consequence directly with capacity deviation, restoring balance without infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process to restore congruence between declared and actual intent
Engage responsibility assumption protocol until integrity baseline is re-established
Implement capacity restoration sequence to eliminate conditions enabling indirect behavior
Execute integrity reintegration cycle through supervised reflective practice
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is executed. Deceit has no place in righteous action. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Reality remains non-punitive. Dharma is restored.
